title: Refresh task-sync byte totals recorded by older CRLF checkouts
outcome: Operators can recover a committed comparison that stored checkout lengths before Git-byte accounting without adding inventory scans to ordinary import.
acceptance: A fixture carrying an older CRLF-sized committed folder head demonstrates the problem and shows that a named rebuild with its own saved basis refreshes the raw Git byte total.
The operator recovery documentation names the explicit rebuild for affected stores.
